meta.name: work-with-pr
meta.description: Full PR lifecycle in a fresh task-owned git worktree: implement via the ulw-loop skill with mandatory evidence-bound manual QA → reviewer-readable English PR → verification loop (CI + Cubic, where Cubic is skipped only when its quota is exhausted) → merge by default → worktree cleanup. Decomposes one task into the smallest atomic, independently-mergeable PRs and builds the independent ones concurrently via one worktree per PR driven by parallel subagents or a team. Unbounded loop: any failing gate sends you back to fix-and-re-QA inside that PR's worktree. Use whenever implementation work needs to land as a PR. Triggers: 'create a PR', 'implement and PR', 'work on this and make a PR', 'implement issue', 'land this as a PR', 'split into atomic PRs', 'parallel PRs', 'work-with-pr', 'PR workflow', 'implement end to end', even when user just says 'implement X' if the context implies PR delivery.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 拆分开发任务为多个独立小改动,自动验证后逐个合并上线。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你经常要把开发任务变成多个独立小改动,逐个通过验证并合入主分支。
copy.tagline_en: Turn one dev task into small verified changes that merge one by one.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often turn dev tasks into small changes requiring individual review and merge.

howto.what: 把任务拆成最小可独立合并的多个PR；每个PR在独立worktree中用ulw-loop实现，并以真实界面上的手动QA证据验证；创建面向审阅者的英文PR，等CI与Cubic审查通过(配额耗尽时跳过Cubic)后自动合并并清理工作区。
howto.when: 当你说“create a PR”“implement and PR”“land this as a PR”等触发词，或上下文表明要实现并交付PR时触发。

say.note: 会新建分支与 worktree，实现后提交 PR。

say.text: 把这项任务拆成最小的原子 PR 并并行开发。
say.note: 多个独立 PR 会并发进行，各自验证合并。

say.text: 实现这个 issue 并走完 PR 流程。
say.note: 包括 CI 与 Cubic 验证，通过后自动合并。

howto.what_en: Splits a task into minimal mergeable PRs; each is built in its own worktree via ulw-loop with manual QA evidence, then PR'd in English. Verifies via CI + Cubic (Cubic skipped only on quota exhaustion), auto-merges, and cleans up worktrees.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say 'create a PR', 'implement and PR', or 'land this as a PR', or when context implies work should land as a PR.

say_en.text: Create a PR for this feature.
say_en.note: Sets up a worktree, implements, and submits the PR.

say_en.text: Split this task into atomic PRs and build them in parallel.
say_en.note: Independent PRs are developed and verified concurrently.

say_en.text: Implement this issue and run the full PR flow.
say_en.note: Includes CI and Cubic verification, then auto-merge.
